Titanic 2: Iceberg's Revenge -A Screenplay-
JACK DAWSON: "No one ever thought about it - but the iceberg didn't just hit us... WE HIT IT!" ROSE DEWITT BUKATER: "What?! Did the crazy science operation that revived you mess with your head? I brought you back because I *LOVE* you!" JACK DAWSON: "I know, but we're in danger here. That iceberg had a family, and they want revenge. They told me when i was about to die... they never expected..." -JACK DAWSON whips out his COOL SHADES and puts them on JACK DAWSON: "I'd be back."
Cut to California Coastline
An iceberg appears in the water, approaching the city at incredible speed. Evacuation sirens begin sounding, people on the beach are screaming, pointing at it and running for their lives. More icebergs are appearing in the water next to it, also rushing for the shore.
ROSE DEWITT BUKATER: "Help!" JACK DAWSON: "Rose! I'm here for you! I'll never leave you!"
The lead iceberg is on the shore now, gliding towards the two protagonists. It pulls out a gun.
ROSE DEWITT BUKATER: "JAAAAACCCKKKKKKK!"
